content.subject: Fintech month‑end close friction
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
Your recent Q&A highlighted how legacy rails stretch month‑end close for many fintechs. When matching stays manual, teams spend days untangling data instead of closing books. That friction pushes month‑end close beyond the typical five‑day window, adding delay. That gap is what we address with an engine that consolidates transaction streams into a single ledger, eliminating the manual step. Is manual reconciliation a current bottleneck for your team?
